summary: This Form 6-K is a routine notification of share deliveries to PDMRs under the NatWest Group 2024 Employee Share Plan. It discloses shares delivered, withheld for tax, and retained for six executives, typical of standard equity compensation reporting. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is merely an administrative disclosure under the UK Market Abuse Regulation, furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer. It indicates no strategic change or corporate action, so it does not warrant a special-situations classification.
